scenes.title: A map of jobs
scenes.accessibleDescription: Architecture shows what each part owns and how the parts connect.

scenes.title: Follow an inquiry
scenes.accessibleDescription: Trace one request from the organizer to a saved record and owner view.

scenes.title: State over time
scenes.accessibleDescription: A workflow names states, allowed transitions, and failure behavior.

scenes.title: Trust boundaries
scenes.accessibleDescription: Check data and access where information crosses a boundary.

scenes.title: Safe retries
scenes.accessibleDescription: A repeated submission should not accidentally create duplicate effects.

scenes.title: Useful detail
scenes.accessibleDescription: A small map can explain responsibilities without choosing every technology.

scenes.title: Draw the system
scenes.accessibleDescription: Label the boxes and arrows that carry an inquiry through the system.

scenes.title: When storage fails
scenes.accessibleDescription: A failure path must preserve truth and offer a useful next step.

scenes.title: Who may act?
scenes.accessibleDescription: Knowing a record ID is not proof someone can change it.

scenes.title: One source of truth
scenes.accessibleDescription: A count and detail view both refer to the same inquiry records.

scenes.title: Repeat without harm
scenes.accessibleDescription: A lost response makes a retry uncertain; design the intended effect explicitly.

scenes.title: Test the map
scenes.accessibleDescription: Ask a person to follow the arrows and explain the failure path.

scenes.title: From map to spec
scenes.accessibleDescription: The architecture names validation; the specification defines its exact rules.
